## `Button` { #button-class }

`public class Button`

A reusable button component built on top of ZStack. The ZStack foundation allows future extension with overlapping layers (icons, loading indicators, badges, ripple effects, etc.).

Returns a `XenoComponent` — all standard modifiers work directly:



```csharp
Button("Save", () => Save())
    .Background(0xFF4CAF50)    // override default color
    .CornerRadius(16)          // override default radius
    .Padding(24, 16)           // override default padding
    .Margin(8)                 // add margin
    .FlexGrow(1)               // fill available space
```

**Constructeurs**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `Button(string label, Action onTap, float fontSize = 16, uint textColor = 4294967295)` | Creates a button. Text-specific properties are set here (not reachable via modifiers). All visual/layout properties are set via XenoComponent modifiers after `Body`. |

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `XenoComponent Body()` | Produces the entity tree for this button. Returns a `XenoComponent` with default styling applied — chain modifiers to customize. Default styling: purple background, 8dp corners, 2dp elevation, 20/12dp padding, and centered text. Internal structure (ZStack-based): ```csharp ZStack {                          ← .Background(purple) .CornerRadius(8) .Clickable(onTap)   children[0]: Text(label)        ← centered via MainAxis + CrossAxis   // Future layers: Icon, Spinner, Badge } ``` |

## `Controls` { #controls-static-class }

`public static class Controls`

Partial class for control-level utilities and helpers. Widget factories (Button, TextBox, Slider, etc.) live in `Widgets`.

## `Widgets` { #widgets-static-class }

`public static class Widgets`

Standard library widget factories. Each returns a `XenoComponent` — devs customize with standard modifiers, the build is handled internally.

Imported globally via `using static XenoUI.StandardLibrary.Controls.Widgets;` in Sdk.props so all widget factories are available without imports.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoComponent Button(string label, Action onTap, float fontSize = 16, uint textColor = 4294967295)` | Creates a text button with default styling. Returns `XenoComponent` — chain any modifier to customize inline: ```csharp Button("Save", () => Save())     .Background(0xFF4CAF50)    // override color     .CornerRadius(16)          // override radius     .Padding(24, 16)           // override padding     .Margin(8)                 // add spacing     .FlexGrow(1)              // fill space ``` Press feedback (15% darken) is automatic. |
| `static XenoComponent TextButton(string label, Action onTap, uint color = 4284960932, float fontSize = 14)` | A flat text button (dialog actions, snackbar actions). Transparent until customized: `TextButton("Undo", Undo).Background(0x1F6750A4)`. |
| `static XenoComponent TopBar(string title, TopBarOptions options = null)` | A top app bar: navigation icon, title (and subtitle) and trailing action icons. Returns a `XenoComponent`, so any modifier still applies. ```csharp TopBar("Inbox", new TopBarOptions {     NavigationIcon = Icons.ArrowBack, OnNavigation = GoBack,     Actions = [new(Icons.Search, Search), new(Icons.MoreVert, ShowMenu)], }) ``` |
